english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the Pattern of the Universe
english_classification.chapter_note: Overwhelmingly substrate chapter — the oldest body-cosmos correspondence teaching dominates. Teaching purity 0.967 with no editorial bridge, no exhortation, and negligible editorial fatigue. Gardner notes redaction from multiple sources/lessons, visible in the distinct teaching blocks: (1) body→cosmic structures (¶2-3), (2) five watches and their conflicts (¶5-16), (3) five body regions→cosmic rulers with ethical framing (¶17-24), (4) four body worlds with seven rulers each (¶25-29), (5) zodiac-body correspondences in two schemas (¶31-36), (6) numerical powers in the body (¶38-39). The ethical framing in ¶18-22 ('Whoever will master X resembles cosmic ruler Y') is the main editorial overlay — it wraps substrate body-cosmos mappings in application to the elect. The three dialogue frame paragraphs are minimal. This chapter preserves some of the most systematic body-cosmos correspondence teaching in the Kephalaia.
